items.title: Pulsar's new mouse is sliced in half to make it genuinely 'crazy-light'
items.summary: 'I swear it came like that,' I say as I chew through half a mouse.

content.v: With mice sensors getting so ludicrously high-spec'd, some competitive gaming mouse brands are instead trying to make the shell as light as possible. Lighter = speedier. And Pulsar is finally joining the uber-lightweight mouse trend, with a 29 gram gaming mouse that is, well, half of a mouse.

Effectively, the new X2F CrazyLight is just the front half of a gaming mouse, including the sensors, switches, and battery. Pulsar is not the first to cut a gaming mouse in half (in fact, the G-Wolves HSK Pro V2.0 has been around for a while and is just 26.8 g).

It's not even the first very light gaming mouse from Pulsar, with the X2 CrazyLight Mini being 35 g, but it is the lightest ever Pulsar mouse, to my knowledge. And it manages to get that weight without going for the honeycomb shell that many other lightweight competitors go for.

According to Pulsar , the new X2F comes kitted with Pulsar's new SX2 sensor, which we don't currently have the stats for. The previous generation XS1 has a DPI of up to 32,000, a max speed of 750 IPS, and acceleration of 50 G. This is the sensor our Jacob Fox had his mitts on when he reviewed the X2 CrazyLight Medium and X3 Crazylight Mini . It also supports up to 8,000 Hz polling. I would assume the XS2 ups some of those stats.

For context, the Razer Viper V4 Pro , which we consider to be the best gaming mouse right now, has Razer's latest Focus Pro sensor and offers 50,000 DPI, with a max speed of 930 IPS, and acceleration of 90 G.
Pulsar LAB : X2F CrazylightSensor: XS2MCU: Nordic 54L15Switch: Pulsar OpticalEncoder: TTC GoldBattery: 210mAWeight: 29gSEPT 28th, 2026 pic.twitter.com/9MlWzFuLKz August 28, 2026

Alternatively, we think the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike is the best competitive mouse right now, and its Hero 2 sensor offers a DPI of 44,000, a max speed of 888 IPS, and a max acceleration of 88 G.

Whether or not the X2F CrazyLight will be the best competitive mouse after its release on September 28 will likely be a combination of how good the sensor is, how well balanced the weight is, and, of course, its price. Unfortunately, we don't have information on any of those yet. Also, even within the competitive mouse scene, it's sure to be pretty niche, since you have to use a fully fingertipped grip to use these kinds of mice.

We haven't got hands-on, so it's hard to say much more, but the only critique I could levy from looks (other than 'where's the rest of the mouse?') is that you can already see the 210 mA battery, so it's a shame it's not hot swappable. A hot-swappable battery could allow for a smaller battery in the device itself, further reducing the weight, and it's just a great way of staying charged at all times. Though that would presumably add on extra weight, which might defeat the purpose for this kind of mouse.

The notion of chopping off half of your gaming mouse to improve speed definitely feels a bit niche to me, but the fact that multiple companies are doing it implies there are many more competitively minded people than I otherwise thought. Let's just hope they aren't in my games. I prefer the easy opponents I'm currently being put up against.

items.title: id Software's former co-owner says they absolutely would've used gen AI back in the day: 'John Carmack would be like making Skynet or something'
items.summary: "I make this joke that someone needs to come up with the 'Half-Life 2 of AI'."

content.v: Generative AI is a hot-button topic in the industry, and for good reason—it's been kinda destructive, whether that's jacking up hardware prices or putting people out of a job —and while there have been some fairly mundane use cases that seem helpful, it's been hard to escape the sheer sense of mania that's built around its use. Or the bad PR, juiced out of the sheer exhaustion we've all had from executives promising the matrix or something .

So, naturally, it came up in a conversation with Tim Willits, the CCO of Saber Interactive and also the co-owner id Software from 1995-2019. Speaking to PC Gamer's own Joshua Wolens at Gamescom 2026 , he notes that: "As most people know, we are experimenting with AI in future games. We don't have it here right now, but we announced [Rideshare Simulator] and I want to clarify things because there's some misconceptions."

If you're wondering why we're talking about a Rideshare sim, here's some context: Saber landed in hot water earlier this month over it, because it seemingly delayed its AI disclosures on Steam for a while , and was exposed as using AI by a former writer who claims they were booted off the team in favour of it.

That same writer was badmouthed by Saber's CEO Matthew Karch, who later apologised . Willits says that Rideshare's main campaign mode and all of its side missions are written by humans, and the AI components are only used for an optional game mode called Free Ride: "We're going to use AI for the passengers, so we can deliver new stories.

"So that is only possible if we use AI for that—this is an experiment. We at Saber want to figure out how we can use this technology, so we're doing it at a small scale to try to learn. We're like everyone else, we're just trying to figure this out. But there is no generative AI in our big titles. No Hellraiser, no Turok, none in Stuntman."

I feel like an asterisk has to hang over that "only possible"—while, yes, churning an infinite stream of dialogue for an optional mode is only possible with generative AI, a free ride mode with enough conversations for it to not grow stale absolutely could've been cobbled together with actual writers and voice actors. Sure, you'd run out eventually, but I don't think anyone's hungry to make Rideshare Simulator their forever game.

Still, Willits emphasises: "We want to experiment, and I do believe that there will be a company—I don't know who—but some game development company will create a game that uses AI in such an amazing way that everyone will be like, 'That's it, that's what we need to do'." He then goes on to joke "that someone needs to come up with the 'Half Life 2 of AI', something that's so amazing that it just launches some type of killer app."

I remain characteristically unconvinced, though in fairness to Willits, I do at least think that—if generative AI does find a use as the core of a videogame—it'll probably be a new genre of its own, rather than trying to create an infinite RPG with infinite NPCs. An act which would just shake out to make something unappealing and meaningless .

The thing that makes me cynical is we keep watching money being burned and datacenters being built precisely because the tech doesn't really seem all that useful for anything other than busywork . When it takes centre-stage, it produces voice acting that's bland , writing that's terrible , and art devoid of direction or memorability , even as it gets more technically proficient.

I'll eat my artificially-generated hat with a side of humble pie if Willits' "Half-Life 2 of AI" game materialises, but a lot of people have swung at that ball and missed, and each time I feel like the bat is a little smaller. Still, Willits says that id Software probably would've used generative AI if it was a thing back in the day—because the studio was always at the cutting edge.

"Yes! Oh, of course. I mean, look at what [id Software] has done. In 1999, when we released Quake 3, it required a graphics card, and we got so much hate for that. People said we were going to ruin the industry. Nobody was going to spend $100 on a video card, and it was the dumbest thing that anyone ever did … I know for sure back in the day if it was available, John Carmack would be like making Skynet or something."

Still, to be fair to Willits, he seems to share my view that the game'll have to prove that generative AI can change the industry itself, rather than via the promises of a CEO somewhere: "The games will speak for themselves, even in our experiment with Rideshare, I encourage people to check it out when it comes out, play it themselves. They may be like 'oh, this is cool! I like this'. And if they don't like it? Fine. And but the games speak for themselves."

items.title: 国产《湮灭之潮》科隆拿奖 击败一众国际IP
items.summary: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamesc…

content.v: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（The Most Epic Game）大奖。这款出自成都团队的处女作，力压《红色沙漠》（Crimson Desert）、《战锤40K》（Warhammer 40K）等国际 IP 胜出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282148544410.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281847317468.jpg
力压国际大作，成都团队首作扬威科隆
gamescom award 由德国数字游戏文化基金会主办，是全球最大游戏盛会科隆游戏展的官方奖项。值得关注的是，「最具史诗感」大奖的往届得主中不乏全球顶级 IP：《塞尔达传说》《怪物猎人：荒野》《生化危机：安魂曲》均曾摘得此桂冠，《湮灭之潮》此番能从中突围，含金量不言而喻。
继全新宣传片「旧日之纱」于开幕夜直播（Opening Night Live）首映、并于科隆展览中心 6 号馆 B-050 展位迎来公开试玩之后，本作凭借酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、电影级的演出品质、独特的幻影骑士系统与史诗级 Boss 战，征服了到场媒体与玩家。将亚瑟王传奇融入「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」的独特设定，正是这一殊荣的最佳注脚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281847437281.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281850213359.png
从格雯德琳的情感旅程，到召唤圆桌骑士对抗半神
“科隆游戏展是行业内最具影响力的展会之一。我们能在这里获得『最具史诗感』大奖，感到非常荣幸。”《湮灭之潮》游戏监制陈琦表示，“从开发之初，我们的目标就是以中国团队的视角，改编亚瑟王经典。这座奖杯，是对我们开发团队辛勤付出、创造力与热情的极大肯定。在众多优秀的提名作品能最终胜出，我们倍感鼓舞，不胜感激。”
自《黑神话：悟空》之后，《湮灭之潮》成为又一款在科隆游戏展斩获大奖的国产单机游戏。从成都东郊记忆的千人试玩会，到德国科隆 gamescom 的领奖台，《湮灭之潮》正将它的瑰奇幻想带向更广阔的世界。

items.title: 被Epic称为中国版战神！国内多家知名大厂投资合作

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564667.jpg
未来能否和国内顶尖单机坐一桌？
文/九莲宝灯
在今年的科隆Gamescom展上，有一款国产游戏引了葡萄君的注意——它就是来自 古神实验室的《古神：风里希》。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564679.gif
这款游戏在今年初，曾经曝光过一小段视频。当时，游戏展现出的特效、打斗，颇具3A感。但自那之后，游戏一直没有展开什么后续动作。因此，我一度以为这是某个小团队的玩票作品，因制作难度太大胎死腹中。
想不到，半年过去，他们突然活跃起来，游戏不仅在不久前的CJ上 放出了可试玩版本 ，这次科隆展还 直接 端出了新的PV 。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564671.jpg
相比于年初放出的内容，他们不仅大改了角色形象，游戏的战斗演出也明显华丽了不少，整体来看，我们已经能从中看出最终的发展方向。
于是，我找到了古神工作室负责人、游戏制作人 盘古刘大锤 ，和他聊了聊这款游戏的开发经历，以及幕后的团队故事。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564668.jpg
盘古刘大锤
这一聊我才发现，从人到团队再到项目，这个 古神实验室 真不简单：
刘大锤06年开始创业，他当时还在北理工读大二，团队参与研发的引擎就已经帮助08年奥运会开幕式做过人员调度工作。
后来他一边创业，一边在港理工读完了硕博，古神的核心团队也一路跟随，团队赚钱后，刘大锤曾给大伙分了房子。如今，他已在行业摸爬滚打了20年。
至于《古神：风里希》，这款游戏比我想象得更受业内重视。不仅有多家业内知名大厂参与了这款游戏的投资或合作，包括原力动画在内的多个曾参与哪吒系列电影的制作团队，也参与到了这款游戏的制作过程中。
刘大锤告诉我，他们的目标，是希望从这部作品开始，通过努力， 未来能坐上国产顶尖单机这一桌 。
但这也更让人好奇了：这家隐世老怪一样的工作室，过去20年到底都在做什么？为什么突然决定出山做单机大作了？他们到底又凭什么能被业界这么多人所重视？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564669.jpg
以下是葡萄君与古神工作室负责人刘大锤的对话内容，为方便阅读，调整为自述形式：
一款中国版《战神》？
我们这款游戏到底什么样？如果让我总结一个核心特点，就是「女娲造人，神仙打架」。
为什么是这8个字？
女娲造人，说的是我们游戏的世界观。作为一款以创世神话为题材的游戏，《古神：风里希》和女娲造人的故事是高度相关的。游戏的主角是女娲用泥土创造的「灵珠子」，她需要通过收集五脏六腑，通过各种修仙途径，从凡人变成神仙，最终达到法天象地的境界。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564670.jpg
神仙打架，说的是玩法。它可以分成好几个方面。
其次，神仙打架和凡人打架，在表现上也有很多不同。我们总结为三个，一是他们能够上天入地，二是他们拥有多样化的法宝，三是他们比凡人有更强的身体素质。
先说上天入地的部分。不管是游戏主角、还是游戏里的其他神仙，他们都能在空中飞行，打的是空地一体化战斗。角色可能会在天上遭遇，然后一路打到地上，也有可能出现空对地/地对空的情况。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564678.gif
这是我们最具独特性的地方，因为面对不同空间位置的敌人，你的对敌姿态、战斗方式也不一样，这意味着我们的战斗动作会非常的多样化。
然后是法宝。很多MMO之类的游戏里可能都有类似的设定，但那些法宝通常是塞背包里的，并不能外显，这样沉浸感就差了很多。我们希望这些法宝能够外显出来，玩家能够看到这些法宝在角色身上。
但这又会带来一个问题：各种各样的法宝背在背后，看着乱七八糟的，不够帅。所以我们就想到一个点子：这些法宝不用的时候，是像衣服一样穿在身上的。
比如哪吒常用的法宝。混天绫平时就是角色的衣服，火尖枪会变成臂甲，风火轮就是腿甲。进入战斗的时候，法宝会从身上脱落，这还能让角色有一种「爆衣」的感觉。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564683.gif
我们还专门按照不同法宝的作用，做了各种特效。为了确保这些法宝能给人强大的感觉，我们还专门去找了《战神》系列游戏和《哪吒》系列动画的制作团队深度合作，把一些影视级的流体、破碎、粒子光照等技术移植到游戏引擎上来。
最后就是神仙的身体素质这方面。神仙打架是比较「体面」的，他们不能直接在地上打滚，通常要先斗法，最后才会伤害到身体。所以我们给这些神仙设计了神力架势条，玩家要先打破这个架势条，才能进入肉搏的阶段。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564672.jpg
到了这个环节，我们希望给玩家爽感。这个游戏本身的战斗门槛其实设计得比较低，玩家上手是很轻松的，不仅如此，我们还会在战斗体验上追求《战神》风格，往爽快华丽的方向做。我们在游戏中还做了大量受击反馈，你用不同的战斗动作攻击敌人，它们的反馈都不一样，保证单位时间内的情绪体验价值拉满。
这里值得扩展一下的是，我们在视觉感受上的设计思路也是一样的。我们计划在游戏中加入很多奇观巨兽，给人最直接的视觉爽感。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564674.jpg
为了给玩家带来这些感受，我们对技术做了很多突破。
像是空地一体化战斗，我们用了Motion Matching 2.0技术，它能让角色在地面与空中展现出各种姿态，并且这些姿态可以无缝切换。这项技术带来的动画AI推演能力，还能让角色在空中冲刺、法宝释放、以不同力度落地时，都有实时物理反馈。
再比如动画反馈。我们在这里用了ML Deformer/Neural morph技术进行实时推理，它能替代传统物理骨骼实时解算，速度提升1000倍。这样一来，角色受击的时候，肌肉、脂肪抖动才能很真实。这种细节能给玩家带来更强烈的视觉刺激。
为了做出更符合我们心中的神仙打架的特效，我们也在流体力学、程序化破碎、体积光方面有技术突破。之前CJ，我也做了一场CGDC技术讲座，讲的是电影级流体解算的游戏应用。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564673.jpg
总之，《古神：风里希》是一款想要主打爽快感和愉悦感的游戏，我们不想在游戏里讲太冗长的剧情，也不希望它变成让人受苦的魂游。我们的一切目标都是让玩家在游玩过程中能收获充分的视觉愉悦感和畅快的体验。
我们最终想做的，其实是有自己特色的中国创世神话版《战神》。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_4755670_4564676.jpg
大学生创业： 自研引擎，做MMO？
我从业已经超过20年了，见过无数黄掉的公司和项目，我们团队可以说是从死人堆里爬出来的。我们穿越过国内端游、手游、3A的流行浪潮，经历过各种高峰和低谷，才艰难活到第三个10年周期。
从创立至今，我们的产品有好有坏，这也让团队多次陷入挣扎。团队能坚持20年，关键可能在于我们的技术基因。
如果不是早年对技术的执念，现在做《古神：风里希》，这些神仙打架的场景包含各种大尺度的空间运动和华丽的特效，没有技术不可能搞得定。
核心团队是2006年在北京理工大学成立的。我当时学的是数字媒体专业，到大二的时候，我已经把学校图书馆里所有和游戏沾边的书全看完了。随后，我拿着大概几千块钱的微软奖学金，就想着组建团队。
为了让人加入我的团队并不容易。我们公司现在的艺术总监，当时是我的师兄，我几乎每天都跑到他的宿舍和他探讨游戏，可以说是三十顾茅庐，最终才说动他加入团队。团队里的每一个人，几乎都是这样一个个找来的。
团队组建好之后，我们计划打造一套属于中国的创世故事，把盘古开天、女娲补天造人等上古传说，用一条连贯线性叙事脉络串联起来。我们很快就拿出了一款基于这套内容的MMORPG，让玩家在上古星球中生存游历。它叫《盘古Online》。
这款游戏有很多遗憾。我们用的是自研引擎，受限于当年的技术和经验，即便我们花了很多心思去搭建完整大世界，设计游玩框架，但游戏整体还是算不上成熟，也没有吸引到太多玩家。
不过当时大学生自研引擎做MMO还是很新鲜的事情，包括新华社、人民日报在内的很多媒体都报道了我们的作品。
当年的开发团队

items.title: 曝布鲁斯威利斯家人考虑捐献其大脑 饱受痴呆症困扰
items.summary: 据外媒Indulge Express报道，71岁布鲁斯·威利斯的家人据称已经开始为他未来的告别事宜做准备，并考虑在其去世后将其大脑捐献给科学…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140095989.png
据外媒Indulge Express报道，71岁布鲁斯·威利斯的家人据称已经开始为他未来的告别事宜做准备，并考虑在其去世后将其大脑捐献给科学研究机构，用于额颞叶痴呆（FTD）相关研究。
不过，目前这一消息尚未得到布鲁斯·威利斯家人的官方证实。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140312989.png
报道称，布鲁斯·威利斯近年来一直受到健康问题困扰。研究人员认为，遗体大脑捐献能够帮助科学界进一步了解神经退行性疾病的发病机制，并推动相关疾病的研究。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282140407486.png
2022年，布鲁斯·威利斯的家人曾公开透露，他被诊断出患有失语症。2023年，家人进一步确认其病情已经发展为额颞叶痴呆。这种疾病可能影响患者的语言交流、行为以及认知能力。此后，布鲁斯·威利斯逐渐退出影视行业。

items.summary: 在《GTA》系列中，玩家过去一直可以全副武装地走在街头，而不用担心引起游戏中NPC的注意。不过，《GTA6》里的NPC将会比前作更加敏锐，这也意味着在公共场合携带武器将要付出代价。根据《纽约时报》对《GTA 6》的预览报

content.v: 在《GTA》系列中，玩家过去一直可以全副武装地走在街头，而不用担心引起游戏中NPC的注意。不过，《GTA6》里的NPC将会比前作更加敏锐，这也意味着在公共场合携带武器将要付出代价。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787923990_758668.webp
根据《纽约时报》对《GTA 6》的预览报道：“在这款游戏中，玩家不能再掏出一把霰弹枪或火箭筒，然后若无其事地走在街上，还指望NPC不会报警。”
《GTA6》将恢复系列经典的六星通缉等级。相比单纯携带火箭筒，玩家开火后显然会惹上更大的麻烦。不过，让NPC面对潜在威胁时表现得更加真实，也为游戏玩法增加了一个玩家今后必须考虑的新因素。
虽然游戏男主角之一杰森的配音表现似乎受到了不少负面评价，但玩家们对《GTA6》的其他方面给予了好评，包括可以与狗互动，以及杰森与另一位主角露西亚之间可能存在的复杂感情故事。
《GTA6》将于11月19日发售，登陆PS5和Xbox Series X|S平台。

items.summary: Xbox似乎准备全面押注游戏改编项目，正向流媒体平台和影视制作公司推介旗下多款游戏。据Puck报道，微软和Xbox一直在就一揽子包含“十多款游戏”的改编项目进行洽谈。该媒体点名提到的作品包括《光环》（再次改编）、《上古卷

content.v: Xbox似乎准备全面押注游戏改编项目，正向流媒体平台和影视制作公司推介旗下多款游戏。据Puck报道，微软和Xbox一直在就一揽子包含“十多款游戏”的改编项目进行洽谈。
该媒体点名提到的作品包括《光环》（再次改编）、《上古卷轴》、《魔兽世界》和《暗黑破坏神》。据报道，Netflix、派拉蒙和环球影业都已经与微软进行过接洽，而微软似乎希望这笔潜在交易的报价能够达到约3亿美元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787923297_390226.webp
Xbox在影视改编领域的表现可谓喜忧参半
亚马逊Prime Video推出的《辐射》系列，取得了巨大成功;《我的世界》电影则在全球票房上突破了10亿美元，目前续集也已经在筹备中。
相比之下，真人版《光环》仅播出两季便被取消，而且该剧对于士官长和星盟的塑造也饱受批评。其他项目，例如《战争机器》Netflix剧集，则已经搁置多年，迟迟没有进展。
Xbox希望将更多旗下IP搬上荧幕，也是当前好莱坞掀起的游戏影视改编热潮的一部分。
《刺猬索尼克4》即将上映，此前该系列已经在过去十年里推出了三部广受好评的电影。《战神》也将登陆Prime Video，不过该剧在拍摄期间发生了主演瑞恩·赫斯特受伤的情况，剧组不得不让戴夫·巴蒂斯塔接替他的角色。
除此之外，还有全新的《古墓丽影》剧集、《塞尔达传说》电影、《艾尔登法环》电影，以及《只狼》动画正在推进。
如今，游戏改编已经远远摆脱了过去的“魔咒”，整个领域正处于蓬勃发展的阶段。未来几年，Xbox能否继续为这股热潮添砖加瓦? 至少我们肯定不会拒绝一部《上古卷轴》真人剧集。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: "30岁没老婆"成定型文！很焦虑 人崩溃了

content.v: 我40岁了，没有老婆，也没有成家，没有不良习惯，也不抽烟也不喝酒，也不赌博，也没有房贷，也没有车贷，没有负债，也没有网贷，目前一个人生活，想成家太难了，实在没办法了，以后家里也没有人了，无儿无女，以后就没有人养老了，如今又很焦虑，人也崩溃了，又是难搞的一天啊。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564537.jpg
以上这些话，如果你真的认真看完了，那么恭喜你，你在这过去的 短短10秒 里，我就已经成功帮你节约了 整整两年多 的时间，不用谢。
没有老婆太难了
一个男人，一个忧郁的男人，一个面无表情的男人，呆呆地坐在床尾，穿着一件洗的已经发皱的黑色或灰色的衣服，身旁摆放着一台 蓝色的电风扇 ，身后的窗子即使外面阳光明媚，也被层层叠叠的衣服遮挡住了阳光。
脸上的表情，是看破一切的麻木，以及对生活失去希望的迷茫。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564542.jpg
（提问：电风扇为什么是蓝色的？）
伴随着名为“忧伤的咪嗦啦”钢琴曲作为背景音乐，在噔噔噔噔噔~噔噔~的舒缓节奏下，男人缓缓的将上文这一整段话娓娓道来，并将各个关键词排列组合。
但不管这天发生了什么事情，这些词怎么排列，核心思想永远都只有一句话： 没有老婆 ；
今天炒了2块钱的红薯叶吃，但是我没有老婆。
今天做了个白切鸡改善伙食，但是我没有老婆。
今天发了工资有四千多块钱，但是我没有老婆。
今天生病了只能躺在医院里，但是我没有老婆。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564538.jpg
而因为这句话重复了太多太多次，以至于配合上某些画面产生了一些不可描述的和谐感，你知道我想说什么，我也知道你想说什么，但是都憋说嗷。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564539.jpg
（没办法就是没办法）
总之在“南瓜乔哥”的视频里，你会发现这世间的一切烦恼和生活的所有意义都可以归结为两个字 “老婆” 。
而没有老婆的他人生就没有了色彩、失去了光明、失去了动力，一个 40岁无不良嗜好的老实中年男性之殇 在乔哥的视频中体现的淋漓尽致。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564540.jpg
如果这样的一个视频你只是第一次看到，或许也会觉得这可能又是一个中年人在互联网上 自娱自乐 ，拍点日常视频发到网上，试图让不知道哪里出现的网友点上个位数的赞并留下几个评论。
但这段话在“南瓜乔哥”这里，只有 “日常视频” 这四个字是正确的！
因为从24年4月9日开始，这两年里乔哥真的是以 几乎每天一个视频 的速度持续不断地向中国互联网发散着自己娶不到老婆的怨气，2年时间一共更新了 615个 视频！
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564541.jpg
在最开始的时候，乔哥没有正经工作，每天躺在小出租屋的铁架床上等待日结工作。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564545.jpg
在一次视频中他讲述了自己的经历，农村长大的他初来广东，就被花花世界迷了眼，年轻的时候每个月工资都拿来吃喝玩乐，以至于整整 19年间 都没有存下来什么钱。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564548.jpg
于是，没有钱就没有老婆、没有老婆就没有生活的意义、没有生活的意义就没有动力赚钱、没有钱就没有老婆……最后得出结论， 人生毫无意义。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564544.jpg
总之在38岁那年，乔哥发现人生在世除了找老婆之外，另一件要事便是在互联网上找老婆。
而根据视频时间推测，在24年12月份，乔哥应该是过完了自己的39岁生日，但很遗憾的是，那年他没找到老婆。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564573.jpg
于是在25年5月份， 乔哥悟了。
世间扰扰，尘念浮沉。
情丝如麻，牵绊难断。
红粉本骷髅之相，凡乱我乔哥心者，皆是虚妄外缘，当以禅心照破，不被色相所迷。
静心修炼，望早日成佛。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564543.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/08/27/origin_3341818_4564549.jpg
但是没办法，没有老婆太难了。
这趟佛门苦修就坚持了5天，但是要知道唐僧西行也才经历了6次色欲道心考验，咱们乔哥也算得上是一步之差，最后一天没忍住，可惜。
不过先别急，就算到了今年40岁了，乔哥也还可以继续尝试这条伟大的“问心”之路。
因为他还是没有老婆。
也是在这一年，乔哥正式在互联网上确立了自己的视频风格：先是一段“没有老婆贯口”，然后开始做菜吃饭，某种意义上来说，也算是一种吃播了。
但说实话，不会有人看到首页这 清一色复制黏贴的视频封面 还能绷得住吧？
AAA恩师南瓜乔哥
总而言之，虽然听起来很抽象，但是在“无儿无女无老婆”这条赛道上，乔哥确实成为了开创者。
这条赛道很挤，但人真的很多。
随着越来越多的年轻人开始刷到乔哥的这些视频，他们很难理解一个40岁的中年男人为什么能够孜孜不倦的在互联网上输出找老婆小视频，但能理解的是，这种事情真的很抽象。
而且最关键的一点是， 这种视频真的很好拍。
一台手机，一张床，一个人，有条件的可以加上一台电风扇，年轻人就可以开始自己的抽象大业，并感谢乔哥开源。
（没绷住，扣一分）

items.title: 在看到《GTA 6》对 PS5 的影响后，我们更加迫切地想知道 PC 版本能为我们带来什么
items.summary: Looking at the PlayStation 5 capture, we're noodling on just what extra shinies Rockstar might add to the best

content.v: So GTA 6 officially slammed into our collective eyeballs last night with a full 26 minutes of pure gameplay (well, that and some cutscenes) and it has made us ever more desperate to get our hands on a proper PC build of the game.

But the hardware team has been poring over the released footage captured on a lowly PlayStation 5 and we've put our heads together to figure out what we think, and what extra bells and whistly things we want to see built into the eventual PC build of the game.

For right now, we have an admittedly beautifully looking game running at a peasant 30 fps frame rate, on a seven year-old Sony console. The top PC hardware of today is far beyond what the aging hardware inside the PS5 is capable of… even if right now the cost of admittance to the world of top PC hardware is inexcusably high. Who knows, maybe by the time GTA 6 is allowed to release on PC the RAMpocalypse will be over? Though that either means GTA 6 won't release on PC until maybe 2031 or the AI bubble pops sending us back into the economic stone age. Cheery thought.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA.jpg
GTA 6 guide : Everything we know GTA 6 cars : The garage lineup GTA 6 characters : Your anti-hero cast GTA 6 editions : What's in each version GTA 6 PC release : When it might happen

Hard shadows, fluorescent lights, dingey hallways, sunlit expanses… the team at Rockstar are putting the PlayStation 5 to work in GTA 6. Though the first five minutes of extended gameplay make me feel as though I'll be adjusting the brightness on my TV to see what's actually going on.

As for the open world, I can spot some reflections and lighting that look like they're rendered in a pretty traditional way, rather than full RT. Look to the shiny floor in Lucia's apartment and the reflection of the windows, from the TV set, or the light coming through the blinds onto the kitchen countertop—we're not getting RT cranked to the max on PS5. Same goes for the storefronts we see Lucia holding up at gunpoint later in the gameplay trailer. Though the car chases look pretty lush out in the amber sun-lit tones of Vice City.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hqB6GBRtAjsZa8FbL5s62H.jpg

We're still trying to spot where effects are more faithfully reproduced out in the open world. We think we've maybe whittled it down to RT for reflections, used sparingly for cutscenes. Though it's definitely a challenge to make out with recorded gameplay going through YouTube's servers.

There do appear to be some RT reflections on the van, puddle, and window around the 16:40-16:50 mark. As Dave also pointed out to me, there's also a touch of what appears to be denoising in some places—on the rear of the van at, say, 16:10—but in other places, RT effects appear pretty low-key or non-existent. Like the molotov cocktail just moments before. A selective approach to balance the beauty of cutscenes and the demands of a massive open world? Makes sense, especially on the PS5's hardware.
With more firepower on PC, a few softer shadows wouldn't go amiss.

With more firepower on PC, a few softer shadows wouldn't go amiss. Some indirect lighting, too, as the shadows look hard enough you could cut them with a knife at times. Presuming GTA 6 will follow in the footsteps of Red Dead Redemption 2 with DLSS support, we should get some help bear the brunt of the graphical load when it does launch on PC.

So, moody lighting, massively high contrast, and gorgeous vistas. It's impressive what can be achieved on this seven-year-old console hardware, no doubt about that; but with that in mind, I'm just more pumped for the PC version after watching this. GTA 6 looks like a game that has the potential to look absolutely stunning with more performance under the hood and when it's not curtailed by outgoing console hardware. It's screaming out for a cutting-edge GPU. It can't come to PC soon enough.

It's a confident move from Rockstar to just put up almost half an hour's worth of actual gameplay, and the lighting looks really quite striking… in stills. Every time I pause the trailer, I admire a little bit of the game's artistry, from its graffiti to the hair of its characters, and it makes the rundown nature of the first building really shine. How good that will be to play is a different matter, as the game's approach to realism does make those dark halls a little darker than I'd want, and without sufficient clarity to easily make out what's going on in an instant.
You can spot Rockstar's pretty incredible attention to detail in some reflections, like you can see Jason in the convex mirror at 12:09.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pCT2MUNacp9HPCi4ShZNxV.jpg
In motion, it looks surprisingly choppy for an official gameplay trailer.

Rockstar's attention to detail can be a double-edged sword though, as things like the fire on the car at 16:04 looking a tad flat or the lack of an accurate viewfinder in the camera at 20:17 make the world feel a little more plastic. These aren't things I would traditionally even care about, but it's Rockstar's approach to its world that makes them feel a little off. Rockstar's history, plus budget, make it the realistic open world maker, so it has become its unique cross to bear.

In fairness, the game looks undeniably good to me. Rockstar has the reputation for engaging, immersive, and realistic worlds for a reason, and the clarity of textures, plus strong lighting, makes GTA 6 look even more immersive and realistic than its predecessor. Whether or not it's as engaging will have to wait until we have it in our hands.

In motion, it looks surprisingly choppy for an official gameplay trailer. There's notable slowdown right after Jason enters the building at the start, and there are plenty of little sections where the flow of the game is just interrupted. But alas, that's the game running on a PlayStation 5, and we PC gamers have the ability to run this game at higher frame rates, especially when we consider the array of upscaling and frame generation. And Rockstar will have some time between the console and PC release to fine-tune the game too. That's the one benefit of us having to wait.

I'll always jump at a chance to add a pretentious word to my writing, so how about this one: chiaroscuro . Or, the contrast created between light and shade. It's interesting to see how often Rockstar plays with the difference between brightly lit streets and dimly lit interiors, or stark shiny highlights set against moody backdrops.

At points, I almost want to adjust the settings of my Mini LED monitor. The apartment raid at 5.25 switches from a grimy, fluorescent-lit hallway into a candle-lit dwelling with plenty of atmosphere, but also creates the sort of black-on-grey, mushy tones that make me squint to see anything that isn't directly lit. This is likely made worse by video compression, but there are plenty of darker moments that I feel would be difficult to read on anything other than a high-end display.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/w4xsQkLdPpDiMC8xcz7xWm.jpg

However, some of the brighter scenes are downright stunning. The meeting scene at the rooftop bar is striking, and the lighting of the character models themselves stands out. The soft shadow on Lucia's right arm as she approaches the bar at 9.55, the highlights in the character's hair. I'll be honest, this is downright impressive for a crowded scene in an open world game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3RuVUiTu4M6ffQCyk5ZkQY.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/esZEq7p2463cNu2mXCwMiC.png
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/oiFZMbBTZjLk3DgE9KzzGi.jpg

items.title: 《巫师3重制版》内存要求翻倍 老电脑瑟瑟发抖
items.summary: CD Projekt Red已公布《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》的PC系统配置要求，相比原版有所提升。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282117472666.png
CD Projekt Red已公布《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》的PC系统配置要求，相比原版有所提升。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282117547924.png
最低配置要求12GB内存，官方推荐16GB内存以获得更佳体验。同时，游戏需要安装至SSD，并预留至少70GB可用空间。此外，如果玩家仍在使用旧版操作系统，需升级至Windows 11方可运行。
目前升级PC并非理想时机。由AI数据中心驱动的全球内存短缺仍在持续，美国政府也在酝酿对半导体相关商品加征更多关税。不过，玩家不必担心重制版发售后会被“卡在门外”——玩家仍可选择不升级至重制版，继续游玩原版《巫师3》。.
《巫师3：狂猎》会提供了一个选项，可以将游戏回滚此前版本，而不是升级版。这对于使用性能较低的电脑或Steam Deck等掌机的玩家来说尤其方便。

items.title: 张子枫晒新照瘦脱相 神似李维嘉
items.summary: 27日，张子枫晒25岁生日照，素颜出镜。瘦了之后五官立体、鼻子高挺，被网友指出神似维嘉。此前张子枫被曝为塑造角色瘦到80斤。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282116442567.png
27日，张子枫晒25岁生日照，素颜出镜。瘦了之后五官立体、鼻子高挺，被网友指出神似维嘉。此前张子枫被曝为塑造角色瘦到80斤。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282116453527.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282116476292.png
为贴合电视剧《河清海晏》中女法医角色的清冷干练，以及电影《我们生活在南京》中末世幸存者的破碎脆弱感。最新《河清海晏》开机路透中，张子枫脸颊两侧明显凹陷，昔日标志性婴儿肥完全消失，下颌线清晰凌厉，身形单薄，被网友形容“瘦脱相”。网传其体重已降至80斤上下，锁骨、肩胛骨清晰可见，部分网友第一眼甚至没认出是她。
张子枫则回应“反正年轻，都感受一下好了”，强调是基于角色需要的主动选择，承诺“会有度、会健康”。

items.title: 《GTA6》放弃易上手转向写实 而这正是R星应该做的

content.v: 将《GTA6》自Netflix首播以来零散发布的各种信息拼凑起来，你或许会发现一个规律：Rockstar Games正在全力打造《GTA6》，力求达到《荒野大镖客2》式的极致真实感。事实上，R星打算更进一步。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787922225_847510.webp

过去《GTA》系列那种轻松、拿来就玩、偶尔甚至可以说毫不费脑的动作体验，可能要成为过去式了。以前你可以随手偷走路边任何一辆车，肆无忌惮地开车撞倒一群手忙脚乱、尖叫着逃跑的NPC。现在，这些可能都要改变。忘掉那种凌晨3点半醉醺醺地玩游戏的时光，忘掉12岁时偷偷摸摸却轻松上手地玩《GTA》的经历，也忘掉下班回家后什么都不用想、开着游戏放松一下的日子。《GTA6》听起来像是要直接追求现实生活本身。事实上，它可能真实到有些时候甚至会让人觉得麻烦甚至尴尬。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787922225_524943.webp
下面就是一些我们目前看到的例子。
首先是通缉系统。
以后你可能再也不能靠疯狂飙车，然后长时间跑出警察那个巨大迷你地图的追捕范围来甩掉警察了——最多也就是给车换个颜色。现在，你可能需要换发型、换衣服、换车辆，甚至改变是否和你的搭档一起行动。又或者，正如Rockstar North联合工作室负责人向IGN透露的那样，你可能干脆得下车徒步逃跑，在游戏里规模庞大的小巷网络中寻找藏身之处。
然后还有全新的“犯罪档案”系统。
看起来，这套系统会记录你的各种行为，无论是残忍还是善良，并影响你在探索世界时其他人对你的反应。也就是说，再也不能毫无后果地掏出火箭筒一路轰过去解决麻烦了。估计以后也不能再像过去那样，把一堆汽车停在加油站旁边，然后扔颗手雷看看一次能炸掉多少辆车，而不用担心有人把这件事记下来。
你还得考虑自己和搭档之间的关系。
据目前信息来看，就连一些看似微不足道的行为，比如你是否会替搭档扶住车门，都可能影响你们之间的关系，而关系又会进一步影响故事的发展。你们可以一起犯罪，也可以各干各的。
除此之外，你还得操心自己的身体状况。
你的外表以及各种属性——具体有哪些属性目前还没有公布——似乎都会受到饮食习惯的影响，包括你吃多少、可能还包括你吃什么;你是否去健身房;以及你是在安全屋冰箱里喝那些昂贵又时髦的果昔，还是一口气灌下好几瓶啤酒。Rockstar承诺，《GTA6》将拥有类似《GTA：圣安地列斯》的身体状态系统，而且还会进一步扩展。
当然，还有一个问题：你到底能不能把面前这辆车偷走。
现在，高档的停放车辆在游戏前期似乎无法直接盗走——除非你像老派《GTA》那样，直接把车里的司机拽出来实施劫车。因为这些车辆自带安全系统，只有随着游戏推进、掌握相应技能后才能绕过。更狠的是，它们还会配备GPS追踪器。你需要开得足够快，才能甩掉追踪器的定位。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787922225_312415.webp
这也与另一个变化相互呼应：在《GTA6》中，驾驶本身，尤其是高速驾驶，将会“更具挑战性”。Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson表示，这是因为游戏里的道路更加密集、更加狭窄——同样是为了更加真实地还原现实中的迈阿密以及整个佛罗里达地区。
而且还不止这些。过去几天泄露的信息中，我们还看到了诸如后备箱储物系统之类的内容，这似乎意味着你以后可能不能再像过去一样，随手从裤兜里掏出一把迷你机枪了。此外，游戏中甚至可能还需要在驾驶过程中给汽车加油。
所以，现在整体情况其实已经相当清楚了：《GTA6》刻意追求真实感，而这必然会牺牲其一贯的易上手性。如果让我猜的话，这种易上手性很可能正是《GTA》系列取得空前成功的重要原因之一，尤其是它总能突破“核心玩家”的圈子，吸引那些通常没什么耐心的大众玩家。怎么看，这似乎都是一次巨大的冒险。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787922225_376931.webp
但说实话，我非常高兴Rockstar愿意冒这个险。虽然我看到过、也很喜欢那些“所以我还得管理自己的排便吗”之类的调侃，也确实担心这种设计最终到底会不会好玩——更别提那些看起来非常像《荒野大镖客2》的操作方式了。我玩那款游戏的时候，有相当多次想按一个按键把自己的帽子捡起来，结果却莫名其妙地一拳打在了马身上——但即便如此，我还是很高兴Rockstar这么做。
因为从根本上说，这正是我们这些年来、这些个月、甚至感觉像在这个游戏行业里度过了漫长岁月的人一直在讨论的问题。太多做决策的人一直在极其谨慎、甚至不合常理地求稳。而最终，这种做法反而伤害了他们自己。
Rockstar拥有一种几乎前所未有的特权：他们正在制作一款几乎可以说是游戏史上最接近“必然成功”的作品。他们拥有大得无法想象的预算，也似乎有足够长的时间去慢慢打磨。而在拥有这种无与伦比的条件之后，他们选择真正去做一件有野心的事情。
这里所说的“有野心”，并不是电子游戏媒体通常使用的那种意义——也就是做一张巨大、昂贵、画面漂亮的地图。真正的野心，是尝试去做一件根本就不容易做到的事情。
而且，如果你开始想想过去几年里真正大获成功的游戏，这件事或许也没那么冒险。《艾尔登法环》《博德之门3》，甚至《集合啦！动物森友会》。这些游戏都火到了甚至登上BBC的程度;那些平时根本不玩游戏的朋友也开始玩了，甚至有人在疫情期间为了《动物森友会》专门买了一台Switch。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787922225_387253.webp
更关键的是，按照大多数人的定义，这些游戏都算不上什么“休闲游戏”。它们都有非常丰富、甚至可以说非常复杂的机制和系统，需要玩家主动去探索，需要经历失败，有时候甚至需要自己去理解那些并没有直接告诉你的东西。
我越这么想，就越觉得这次可能根本算不上什么冒险。难度和操作上的不便同样可以卖得很好，尤其是在如今这个时代——现代数字生活越来越顺滑、越来越无摩擦，人们反而开始越来越渴望一些真实的阻力和摩擦感。
当然，要让“给汽车加油”这件事变得有趣，依然会非常困难。让我在街区里狂奔、翻垃圾桶、钻后院，而不是开着一辆仿法拉利的跑车逃避警察，同样很难做得有趣。让我照顾那个像塔玛戈奇一样的伙伴，同时扮演一个没那么邪恶的坏人，再让我在决定偷走一辆车之前亲自把每辆车都扫描一遍——这些事情也都很难。
Rockstar最终能不能把这些东西做好，还不好说。但他们确实有可能做到。而如果说有哪家工作室有资格、也有责任去尝试这件事，那毫无疑问就是Rockstar。

content.v: 由Motive Studios开发、EA发行的《漫威钢铁侠》游戏近日疑似遭泄露，一段标记为“开发中版本”的实机预告在网络上流传。尽管素材中大量资产尚未完工，但已清晰展示了本作的核心玩法与世界观架构。
视频：
泄露视频展示了钢铁侠标志性的飞行与战斗系统，玩家可操控托尼·斯塔克在空中高速机动，发射掌心炮与导弹进行远程攻击，亦可近身格斗。装甲定制界面也同步曝光，暗示本作将提供多样化的战甲改装选项。

items.title: Sabre回应拼车游戏中人工智能的批评并承诺，“我们永远不会解雇某人并用人工智能取代他们”
items.summary: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative

content.v: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative AI. It's a hot-button issue, and few companies have faced the level of criticism about it as Saber has. The developer recently found itself in hot water after CEO Matthew Karch lashed out at Rideshare Stimulator's former writer who said they were laid off and replaced by ChatGPT.
Now, Saber's chief creative officer, Tim Willits, has addressed the situation as well, promising that, "We will never fire someone and replace them with AI."

For anyone just catching up, Rideshare Stimulator is an upcoming Saber game where players take on the role of an Uber- or Lyft-like driver and interact with them as they take them to their location. The developers freely admit to using generative AI in various capacities, and now Willits has shed more light on the situation. He said the game's main campaign features dialogue written by humans, but there is also a "free ride" mode where Rideshare Stimulator wants to be able to reference current events in the real world.
"We use AI to generate that because we want to do it so fast," Willits said, adding that the plan is for weekly or biweekly updates with this kind of AI-generated content.

Willits also clarified that some of Saber's other games, including the new Hellraiser, Turok, Stuntman, and Space Marine games, also do not use AI. Saber, like many other game companies, is experimenting with AI in various ways.

"We want to figure this new technology out, and we don't know exactly where it's gonna go, and our players don't know where it's gonna go, so we're all ... all of us are trying as a society to figure this out together," he said. "We want to experiment with it. I personally believe somebody [at] some game company will come up with such a brilliant idea, and we'll all be like, 'That's it.' We just need to get there."

When asked specifically about claims that Saber is firing people and replacing them with AI, Willits said this is not true. "I promise you we have never let anyone go and replaced them with AI. We hire people all the time," he said.

A spokesperson for Saber previously told PC Gamer that neither Saber nor Rideshare developer Unigine replaced any writers with AI for that game or any others. "In fact, Saber's staff of writers has tripled since 2023. Rideshare's story was written entirely by real people," the company said.
Rideshare's "experimental, free-ride mode" does use generative AI "by necessity," Saber said, because "the number of passengers in the game is infinite."

"We are firm believers in using AI tools to improve or enhance gameplay experiences and improve NPC behavior as we have done since Saber was founded in 2001. As the industry has continued to contract, Saber continues to hire. None of our 3000+ employees have to worry about being replaced by AI," the developer said.

The writer in question, Stella Sacco, said Karch reached out to "apologize unreservedly" for how he spoke about Sacco. Karch had said , "Stella who? I had to ask Claude because I have never spoken to her or seen her."
Sacco added in a statement that Karch said "he regretted escalating and how people online were speaking about me."

"I'm not worried about being called slurs by random commenters--I'm a trans woman; that's every day for me. But it stunk to have my skill and reputation built of 20 years in games publicly maligned by someone with institutional power."

items.title: Hellraiser: Revival Is More Than Just Cenobites and Gore – 10 Things We Learned From Saber Interactive
items.summary: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrif

content.v: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrifying-- and horny --dive into the nightmarish fiction of author Clive Barker. So far, the game is looking like the kind of Hellraiser experience that defined the franchise throughout the '80s and early '90s, and at Gamescom, Saber Interactive sat down with GameSpot to talk about the game, how far they're willing to go to nail the vibe of Hellraiser , and more.
Hellraiser: Revival launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 6.
Cliver Barker was a "permissive" partner

The legendary creator of Hellraiser needed some convincing before he started collaborating with Saber Interactive, but once he was assured that the developers had a grasp of the Hellraiser franchise, he gave the studio the freedom to tell their own tale within that dark universe. "Clive Barker was such a permissive partner to work with," narrative director Anthony De Fault said. "He was really supportive of our ideas. He basically just wanted to make sure we understood Hellraiser as a franchise, and then, once he knew that we had the, we were channeling the same spirit that he was channeling back in the '80s, he just let us go."
Capturing the soul of Hellraiser's greatest hits

For the game, Saber Interactive aimed to capture the "soul" of the franchise, drawing not only from the recognizable visual elements established in the Hellraiser movies, but also from Clive Barker's original novella, The Hellbound Heart, which served as the source material for the franchise. "This game is a response, specifically to The Hellbound Heart, the first film, and Hellbound: Hellraiser 2, the second film," de Fault said. "So it's just the things that Clive was involved with that resonated really strongly with people back then. We wanted to make something that renewed that and had the same soul, but for a new medium and 40 years later."

Barker was also credited as an executive producer on the third and fourth Hellraiser movies, but had no active production or creative involvement in the franchise until 2022's Hellraiser reboot. That gap saw six Hellraiser movies released, although fans usually consider this period a low point for the franchise.
Saber Interactive isn't afraid of pushing ratings boards to the limits

From what we've seen so far, Hellraiser: Revival looks like it'll be going all in on the extreme subject matter of Barker's work. Saber Interactive has confirmed that the game is going to be gory and sexy, as the studio didn't want to compromise on their vision--even if that meant it faced the risk of being denied classification in several regions. Why go that far? Because doing anything less was seen as a disservice to Hellraiser fans.

"We knew what Hellraiser ought to be. We knew how disappointed Hellraiser fans would be if we did compromise, so it was just never really on the table," de Fault explained. "We wanted to pitch it at a point where I don't know if the executives would necessarily have agreed with this at the time, but we always felt like, if we get denied a rating in one or two places, we've probably done our job right. It was just important to us to do everything with purpose. All of the depraved stuff that you might encounter in the game, I think everything in there is defensible in terms of there's a reason it's there. It's not just for shock value. "It's like a good discomfort."
"Comforting discomfort," Esov added. So far, it looks like the game will be available in the US, at least, as it has received an ESRB rating .
It was all about execution

While all of that comforting discomfort is designed with a purpose in mind, don't be too surprised if Hellraiser: Revival makes you reach for a bucket. One scene in particular might be hard to stomach, as de Fault described it as a moment of "consensual mutilation" in the game.

"There's a consensual mutilation scene. In early versions of this, we failed to adequately convey to players that this was consensual. So, some people came away thinking it wasn't and that it was pretty distressing, and so we had to course-correct that. I think our intent was fully realized in the game. There wasn't really anything we wanted to do that we scaled back or anything like that. We just had to correct the execution in some places."
Hellraiser: Revival takes place in the ancient year of 2006

Hellraiser: Revival is set in 2006, in the small town of Claireport. Saber Interactive chose this time period as a bridge between '80s Hellraiser and the modern era, while also ensuring there wouldn't be any "super high-techy stuff" to distract players. "We still wanted it to feel like an older franchise, but just without going all the way back to the '80s," de Fault added.
Pinhead has an agenda

Like most Hellraiser movies, Revival revolves around a pair of sex freaks who get more than they bargained for when they use one of the infamous puzzle boxes created by the Cenobites--the all-new Genesis Configuration in this instance. Playing as Aiden, it'll be up to players to rescue his girlfriend Sunny from the Cenobites, and you can expect to run into Pinhead at several points in the story.

"He plays a really substantial role," de Fault explained. He appears near the start of the game with all the other Cenobites, responding to the fact that Aiden and his girlfriend, Sunny, have used one of the configuration boxes from the game during their sexual play. In Hellraiser fashion, [the Cenobites] demand a soul, and they take somebody away who happens to be Sunny. "I probably shouldn't go further than that, but Pinhead, you encounter him multiple times. The deal that you have with him has its twists and turns, and it evolves."
Pinhead is also voiced by Doug Bradley, the actor who played him in several Hellraiser movies over the decades.
The "Genesis Configuration" box is fueled by suffering

While previous Hellraiser media revolved around the Lament Configuration puzzle box, the Genesis Configuration is a completely new creation for the game. It serves as both a plot device and a weapon, but to use it, you'll need to fuel it with the suffering of enemies and Aiden's own anguish. Saber Interactive isn't spilling the beans on how it fits into the overall story of Hellraiser: Revival, but they did tease that it was made for a specific purpose that will be revealed eventually.

"It's all in the name of this glorified violence, and basically, it gets powered by the suffering of yours and others," game director Emil Esov explained. "When there is suffering in the vicinity, you get more energy into the box, and you can perform these abilities."
Cenobites can't be trusted

Don't expect to be taking on iconic Cenobites in Hellraiser: Revival. They serve a variety of roles in the game, helping Aiden to unlock new powers for the Genesis Configuration or acting as unstoppable antagonists you'll have to escape. The female Cenobite--sometimes referred to as the Fallen because she was a nun who was drawn to sin in her human life--will also serve as a devil on Aiden's shoulder when she's not unlocking new powers for the Genesis Configuration.

content.v: 近日，有模组作者将《NBA 2K27》抢先体验版中泄露的DLSS相关文件注入《赛博朋克2077》，并成功在游戏中尝试启用尚未正式上线的DLSS 5功能。
演示视频：
据了解，DLSS 5并非传统意义上的超分辨率技术，而是基于实时神经渲染的全新方案。其通过分析游戏提供的颜色信息与运动矢量，由AI进一步推断并生成更加真实的光照、材质和细节，例如皮肤次表面散射、接触阴影等效果，在尽可能保留原始几何结构和美术风格的同时，让游戏画面更加接近电影级路径追踪的视觉效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282052173547.jpeg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608282052187404.jpeg
从目前的实验画面来看，开启DLSS 5后，角色皮肤质感更加真实，材质细节得到强化，光照与阴影也显得更加柔和、立体，整体画面呈现出更强的照片级真实感。
不过，这种视觉提升似乎也伴随着相当明显的性能代价。部分玩家反馈，DLSS 5的神经重构可能导致30%至50%的帧率下降。在RTX 5080上同时开启路径追踪与DLSS 5后，部分测试场景的实际帧率甚至会跌至40FPS以下。
需要注意的是，目前玩家使用的DLSS 5属于通过泄露文件进行的非官方实验性测试，并不代表最终正式版本的实际表现。DLSS 5预计将于2026年秋季正式推出，届时其画质表现、性能开销以及具体支持的游戏仍有待进一步观察。

items.title: 战争机器：E-Day 必须解决一个大的传说问题 - 如何让一名枪骑兵加入游戏？
items.summary: When Gears of War first debuted in the Xbox 360 generation, it introduced the world to the majesty of the Lanc

content.v: When Gears of War first debuted in the Xbox 360 generation, it introduced the world to the majesty of the Lancer weapon. A gun with a brutally effective chainsaw mounted to it, the Lancer has become the defining symbol of the franchise, and in Gears of War: E-Day , players will get to see just how that weapon came to be.

In the established Gears of War lore, the weapon was created a year after the events of Emergence Day. That created something of a dilemma for the developer, The Coalition, as they had to give players something that reminded them of the classic weapon while telling a story that takes place during Emergence Day. The Solution? A Lancer prototype that's introduced in the game, and has roots in Gears of War literary stories.

"Wherever possible, we've just done everything we can to respect the canon, right? The scene where Tai uses a chainsaw in a grocery store to kill a Locust is part of the creation story that was in a book, but we've lifted it--like all the dialogue--everything is intact in our game," creative director Matt Searcy said to GameSpot. "So even if we have to do like a small retcon, we just lift it and drop. We took the moment, we took the dialogue, we took everything about it and just said if we have to make a change, we're going to respect it as much as we possibly can, and if we need to connect the dots between two things, we're going to."

"We have to have a Lancer in this game. In the lore, it's created a year after E-Day by Marcus' father, so we find ways--like we revealed in our campaign preview where a prototype is built around E-Day--so we can feed into all of those things. It just takes a little bit of care and attention, and then there's usually a great creative solution to be able to respect all of the hard work that's come before and all the things the fans are deeply attached to."

The book that helped inspire the story of Gears of War: E-Day is the 2008 novel Gears of War: The Aspho Fields by Karen Traviss. In it, Gear soldier Tai Kaliso uses a power saw in combat, and that action eventually goes on to inspire the creation of the chainsaw attachment for Lancer rifles. The book also covers the battle in which Dominic Santiago's brother, Carlos, dies, giving The Coalition an established starting point for building Marcus and Dom’s relationship throughout E-Day.

"What it gave us was a really rich jumping-off point," Searcy explained. "So we knew E-Day is a plot point, two-thirds of the population dies, the monsters come out of the ground, and it's a cool concept. But we needed something rich for the characters to be based on, and that gave us a really strong starting point in terms of understanding where Marcus and Dom were before this game."

While the story campaign has been a big focus for the early marketing of Gears of War: E-Day, we're not entirely convinced yet if it'll tell the definitive Gears story that sets up the entire franchise. The multiplayer might be where this prequel truly shines--especially with the overhauled movement systems--and you can check it all out for yourself when Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC.

从官方公布的画面来看，桂妮薇儿拥有一头银白如雪的长卷发，她的双眼被半透明、带有冰晶质感的银色蕾丝眼罩遮挡，额间则镶嵌着一枚精致的蓝宝石额饰。
从剧情来看，桂妮薇儿似乎与女主角格雯德琳有着重要联系。她将开导格雯德琳，让其逐渐接受属于自己的命运，并最终踏入被灰雾撕裂的伦敦，开启后续冒险。

《湮灭之潮》此前曾凭借独特的末世伦敦设定以及融合亚瑟王传说的世界观受到玩家关注。随着“旧日之纱”公布，桂妮薇儿这一神秘角色正式揭开面纱，也让格雯德琳与灰雾、命运以及伦敦之间的故事更加扑朔迷离。

items.title: Xbox Series X25开启预购秒售罄 黄牛倒卖价格翻30倍
items.summary: 微软限量版25周年纪念版Xbox Series X——Xbox Series X25最近开启了预购，然而出乎意料的是，这款史上最贵的Xbox主机（900美元）在短短一分钟内便售罄。虽然部分Xbox粉丝抢到了这款纪念版主机

content.v: 微软限量版25周年纪念版Xbox Series X——Xbox Series X25最近开启了预购，然而出乎意料的是，这款史上最贵的Xbox主机（900美元）在短短一分钟内便售罄。
虽然部分Xbox粉丝抢到了这款纪念版主机，但黄牛也抢了不少，这些人正在eBay等网站上倒卖这些主机来大赚一笔。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787920284_396186.webp
在电商平台上，数十台Xbox Series X25上架，价格从2200美元到27426美元不等，最高价27426美元，价格翻了30倍，不过这很可能是为了抢占eBay搜索结果的榜首位置。
微软开放预购时，Xbox Series X25定价为900美元，所以现在的价格涨幅相当惊人。目前看来，已经有不少主机以加价后的价格卖出，eBay上的几笔交易平均每台售价在1900美元-2300美元之间。
这再次让人想起本世代主机初期上市时也有类似的经历：由于半导体短缺，Xbox Series X和PS5 一机难求。黄牛利用各种手段和程序迅速抢购线上补货，然后转手倒卖。不过，供应链最终趋于稳定后，购买本世代主机也变得容易了一些。
这是黄牛党毁掉的又一件事，许多爱好都受到了这种投机文化的影响。宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏受到的冲击尤其严重，零售商每次补货，黄牛党都会抢购一空。就连宝可梦甜甜圈也未能幸免。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《逃脱学院2：再返校园》公开全新校园与第二章试玩内容
items.summary: 由 Coin Crew Games 开发、 iam8bit Presents 发行的合作解谜游戏《逃脱学院2：再返校园》（Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School）公开了更多游戏内容。随着最新试玩版

content.v: 由 Coin Crew Games 开发、iam8bit Presents 发行的合作解谜游戏《逃脱学院2：再返校园》（Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School）公开了更多游戏内容。随着最新试玩版本在德国科隆展的开放，玩家现在得以进一步了解游戏前两个章节的冒险，并首次深入此前尚未展示的科学校区。
作为获奖解谜游戏《逃脱学院》的正统续作，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》并不满足于简单地增加更多密室，而是将系列原有的密室逃脱玩法扩展至一座可以自由探索的巨大校园，试图打造一款真正意义上的“开放世界密室逃脱游戏”。
前作已经吸引超过400万名玩家体验，而这一次，无论是第一次入学的新生，还是准备“再返校园”的老同学，都将面对一所规模更大、秘密更多，也更加危险的逃脱学院。
如需了解更多关于游戏的资讯和福利，欢迎加入逃脱学院2：再返校园的官方QQ群：2163072443
第二章首次公开：前往科学校区！
完成校园中的一系列任务后，游戏将正式进入第二章。这一次，玩家需要前往学院的科学校区，并在那里与一位全新角色——Von Bellini教授会合。
科学校区的前期内容包含两个入门级谜题房间，而目前可以公开展示的内容已经覆盖至化学实验室谜题完成。顾名思义，这一次的“课程”将把科学实验与密室解谜结合起来。
观察环境、寻找线索、理解机关之间的联系，再利用手边能够找到的一切想办法解决问题——虽然校园变得更加开放，但系列最核心的“密室逃脱感”并没有消失，而是被进一步融入了不同学院、课程和校园环境之中。至于化学实验室之后还会发生什么？为了避免剧透，我们还是把答案留到正式上课之后吧。
https://image.gcores.com/526e9e51efbc57e0d56c862f90f2cdc1-1268-714.jpeg
科学之外还有艺术！欢迎来到艺术校区
除了目前试玩能够接触到的内容，开发团队近期还通过开发日志进一步展示了另一片极具特色的区域——艺术校区。与科学校区截然不同，艺术校区在视觉设计上大量参考了西班牙建筑风格。
彩色灰泥墙、陶土瓦片、铁艺阳台与栏杆、手绘招牌以及砖石路面共同构成了整个区域，而随处可见的颜料飞溅痕迹、壁画、涂鸦与雕塑，则不断提醒玩家：这里教授的，是逃脱的“艺术”。
整个艺术校区沿着陡峭的山坡与海岸悬崖层层向下展开。山顶坐落着Hall of Escapists与Workshop，层叠式阶梯一路向下延伸，将一个个工作室与教室连接起来，形成了一座依山而建的小型艺术村落。
其中一些值得关注的地点包括：
The Monument of Escape
服装店
舞蹈工作室
剧院
当然，开发团队目前还没有准备让我们看清这些建筑内部究竟藏着什么。
https://image.gcores.com/d1ad493b120f6d825d2a8a69a152e90a-1268-714.jpeg
一位有点吓人的艺术教授
负责艺术校区大部分课程的是 Enora Chortkoff教授。而“严格”，可能都是一个比较温和的形容。Enora年轻时曾被The Showman's Studio的一场演出深深吸引，并从此梦想着有一天能够亲自站上那个舞台。
她开始把几乎所有业余时间投入到表演艺术中——看戏、写剧本，并不断训练自己掌握的各种表演技巧。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》的故事发生在她人生最大失败的10年之后。当年，Enora终于获得机会，在Jacob Surovskey著名的谋杀悬疑剧《The Death of the Artist》中饰演Ruby LeClue。然而，她过于执着于让自己的表演达到“完美”，反而忘记了真正重要的事情：把它演好。
那次失败让她再也不敢站在观众面前。后来，Solange向她伸出了手，邀请她来到逃脱学院，成为这里的表演艺术教授。于是如今的学生们，也终于有机会亲自感受Enora教授对于“艺术”的严格要求。
https://image.gcores.com/6fbeba0d748328254d66fdc9feec4054-1268-714.jpeg
一个人动脑，还是两个人一起“坐牢”？
和前作一样，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》依然可以完整单人游玩，但合作体验也是本作的重要组成部分。游戏全部内容均支持在线双人合作以及本地分屏合作，玩家可以叫上一名同学共同探索校园、交换自己发现的线索，并一起挑战各种精心设计的逃脱房间。
对于不喜欢在倒计时压力下解谜的玩家，本作还加入了全新的可选“无计时模式”。不管是经验丰富的解谜高手，还是第一次接触密室逃脱的新生，都可以选择适合自己的节奏完成课程。
与此同时，初代负责音乐的 DJ Doseone 也将回归，为这场校园生活带来一系列全新的音乐。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》将登陆 PC、Xbox Series X|S与Xbox One 平台。游戏试玩版目前已可在Steam体验。

items.title: 心理生存恐怖游戏《Holstin》确定2027年登陆PC及主机
items.summary: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于 2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass 。 <内嵌内容，请前往机核查看> 游戏故事发生在

content.v: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass。
游戏故事发生在20世纪90年代初，一座与世隔绝、正在逐渐腐朽的波兰小镇遭到某种未知且不可见的恐怖力量侵蚀。《Holstin》将经典生存恐怖游戏的独特氛围与极具辨识度的背景设定和美术风格相结合，为玩家呈现一场阴暗而诡异的生存之旅。
https://image.gcores.com/c051157de9ed9f00d9ea307c0c84b5d0-1268-714.jpeg
独特2XD渲染技术，在像素世界中自由切换视角
《Holstin》采用Sonka自主研发的 2XD Rendering技术，通过实时光照和动态镜头视角，让这个阴森诡异的像素世界真正“活”起来。
玩家可以在8个不同角度之间旋转镜头，探索Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇每一个被黏液覆盖的角落，并根据不同场景无缝切换游戏视角。
游戏包含多种截然不同的表现方式，包括：
等距3D视角
激烈战斗中的越肩视角
驾驶车辆时的第一人称视角
俯视角探索
横版平台动作
多种视角和玩法形式相互结合，创造出在像素风格游戏中极为少见的视觉体验。
深入被诅咒的波兰小镇，寻找失踪的好友
游戏讲述了主人公 Tomasz Wolanski 的故事。
为了寻找自己失踪的好友，他来到坐落于湖畔乡间的小镇 Jeziorne-Kolonia。他的好友是一名调查记者，最后一次被人看到正是在这里。
然而，当Tomasz真正踏入小镇后，他很快发现这里已经被某种难以名状的恐怖力量所笼罩。
想要从游荡在被诅咒小镇中的怪物手下活下来，玩家必须不断搜寻武器、补给以及任何可能帮助Tomasz生存下去的物资。
怪物却并不是这里唯一的危险。
小镇中为数不多的幸存居民也在逐渐失去理智。玩家需要顺着他们越来越严重的妄想与其交流。如果能够获得这些居民的信任，他们或许会提供重要线索以及解开谜题所需要的信息。
但想要揭开他们隐藏的秘密，则需要玩家更加谨慎、机敏地与他们周旋。
https://image.gcores.com/65c15f0d3edf1e6dafe6f1557f7019f6-1268-714.jpeg
重现90年代后苏联时代东欧风貌
《Holstin》致力于还原20世纪90年代后苏联时代东欧地区的独特面貌与氛围，其中尤其聚焦于波兰。
从Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇中的家具和日常用品，到商品品牌、标识、建筑与室内设计，每一个细节都经过精心设计，以重现那个时代。
褪色的墙纸、破旧的家用电器、年代久远的广告以及随处可见的日常用品共同构成了这个世界，让玩家即使观察最微小的角落，也能够感受到浓郁的时代气息。
与此同时，游戏将提供完整的波兰语及英语配音，玩家可以选择自己喜欢的语言体验这个陌生而又令人不安的世界。
波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima打造原声音乐
《Holstin》诡异压抑的氛围还将通过专门为游戏创作的音乐进一步得到强化。
游戏原声由波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima负责创作，在阴森诡异之余又带有令人平静的独特气质，并包含完整的波兰语人声演唱及歌词。

items.title: FS社新作参考赛文奥特曼 宫崎英高本人很喜欢
items.summary: 近日，《艾尔登法环》与《黑暗之魂》系列开发商FromSoftware社长、导演宫崎英高在接受采访时，谈到了《黄昏血族》角色卓克的设计灵…

content.v: 近日，《艾尔登法环》与《黑暗之魂》系列开发商FromSoftware社长、导演宫崎英高在接受采访时，谈到了《黄昏血族》角色卓克的设计灵感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251522477652.png
宫崎英高透露，卓克最初的设计概念是“从深海中出现的血誓者”。 而他本人一直非常喜欢《奥特曼》以及《奥特赛文》系列作品，其中一些从海洋深处出现的怪兽给他留下了深刻印象，因此成为卓克早期设计的重要灵感来源。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251525296248.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251523347990.png
虽然随着游戏开发推进，卓克最终的形象与最初构想已经出现了一些变化，但这一来自深海怪兽的设计思路被保留了下来。
卓克最显眼的特征之一，就是其造型奇特的鸟嘴。宫崎英高还介绍称，这个嘴部并不只是为了视觉效果，实际上还与角色的战斗方式有关——卓克能够伸长自己的嘴部，像吸管一样吸食其他角色的血液。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251523469841.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251525458324.png
这一设定也进一步契合了角色“血誓者”的身份，让卓克看起来更像一个来自深海、拥有诡异生物特征的怪物。
作为FromSoftware首次尝试的大规模多人动作游戏，《黄昏血族》与《黑暗之魂》系列的传统单人体验存在明显区别。宫崎英高此前也曾多次强调，本作拥有独立的世界观与玩法体系，而卓克这种融合深海怪物、《奥特曼》式特摄审美以及吸血能力的角色设计，也展现了FromSoftware在新作中的独特创意。

items.title: What Console Should You Buy for GTA 6? We Break Down PS5 vs. Xbox Pricing, Deals, and More
items.summary: What is the best console to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on? We break down PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X pricing,

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-6-ps5-vs-xbox-1787918236921.png

Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally starting to feel real. After years of trailers, delays, rumours, and more leaks than Rockstar Games would probably care to count, we've now had our best look at the game yet, thanks to the extended look trailer , alongside our dedicated GTA 6 preview right here on IGN .
And now, finally, it's just a matter of months before we can actually play it. GTA 6 launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026, with pre-load beginning on November 12 .

But there's still one pretty important question to answer: which console should you actually use to play GTA 6? And should you even buy a console for it, or simply wait for the inevitable PC release instead?

Look, there's no doubt that the vast majority of players will end up playing GTA 6 on PS5 . Sony's console has a sizeable lead over Xbox Series X|S, with around 95 million PS5 consoles sold , compared with an estimated 35 million Xbox Series X|S consoles .
But it's not quite as simple as saying, "play it on PS5, like everyone else."

For starters, plenty of people still haven't made the jump to the current generation. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, GTA 6 could well be the game that finally convinces you to upgrade. Unfortunately, you couldn't have picked a much more expensive time to do it, with console prices, games, storage, and just about everything else seemingly getting pricier by the minute. It's a sign of the times, I'm afraid.

Rockstar has also yet to confirm the game's frame-rate targets , but current expectations point towards 30fps on the standard PS5 and Xbox Series X . That's hardly surprising given the sheer scale and visual ambition of GTA 6, but it does raise an interesting question about the PS5 Pro.

The Pro has considerably more horsepower than the standard PS5, along with PSSR upscaling, so you'd expect it to have an advantage. Whether that advantage will be enough to push GTA 6 to 60fps, however, is another matter entirely.

I'd be more surprised if the PS5 Pro didn't offer some kind of visual or performance advantage, but I'd be very wary of buying one on the assumption that it will deliver a locked 60fps. Until Rockstar confirms its performance targets, that's simply not something anyone can guarantee.
That being said, if you forced me to give an answer, the PS5 Pro is still probably going to be top option for getting the best performance for GTA 6. If only it wasn't so horrendously expensive.
Should You Buy a Console to Play GTA 6?

If you don't already own a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S , GTA 6 presents a slightly awkward conundrum. On the one hand, this is arguably the biggest game release of the generation, and you're probably going to want to play it as soon as it arrives. On the other, buying an entire console for one game is an increasingly expensive proposition in 2026.

Sony's current US prices put the PS5 Digital Edition at $599.99 , the standard PS5 with a disc drive at $649.99 , and the PS5 Pro at a frankly eye-watering $899.99 . Microsoft isn't doing much better, with the Xbox Series S now costing $499.99 and the Xbox Series X reaching $749.99 for the digital model or $799.99 with a disc drive. Yikes.

Yet, somehow, despite these bonkers prices, there's somehow also an argument for buying sooner rather than later. Console prices have been consistently heading in the wrong direction, and the broader component shortage isn't exactly helping. Major retailers have already warned that console stock could struggle to keep up with demand over the holiday period, with one senior games buyer claiming retailers have been told they won't receive the number of consoles they want ahead of GTA 6's launch.

That's not exactly a guarantee that you'll be fighting scalpers for a PS5 come November, though. Sony insists it has secured enough memory to hit its PS5 sales target for the financial year, despite the ongoing component difficulties. Yet, with GTA 6 expected to drive a huge upgrade cycle, I'd rather have my console sorted well before November 19 than find myself scrambling for one at the last minute.

Still, if you can, I would still avoid rushing out and paying full price for a console simply because GTA 6 is coming. If you're starting from scratch, keep an eye out for bundles, retailer promotions, trade-in offers, and, particularly as we get closer to November, any GTA 6-specific console deals that might appear.
The Best PS5 and Xbox Console Deals Right Now
Speaking of console deals. While it's slim pickings out there, there are still some potentially decent offers to consider in the run-up to GTA 6's launch.
Top of the list right now is Best Buy, with the retailer offering a $50 reward certificate to anyone who bundles a Grand Theft Auto 6 preorder with an eligible PlayStation 5 or Xbox console .

That's not a bad offer, particularly if you go for the refurbished PS5 at $539.99 . You're effectively getting $110 off the current $649.99 price of a new disc-drive PS5, plus another $50 in Best Buy credit to put towards a future purchase. Just bear in mind that this is the original 2020 PS5 model, complete with its 825GB SSD, rather than the newer, slimmer 1TB model.

And honestly, refurbished is where I'd be looking right now if you're trying to keep the cost of getting GTA 6-ready as low as possible. You're not going to get much of a discount on brand-new PS5 hardware at the moment, so a reputable refurbished model can make considerably more sense.

That's why the next deal I'd consider is a certified refurbished PS5 directly from PlayStation through the PS Direct store . A refurbished PS5 is currently $549, while the refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is $499.

That makes the choice between Best Buy and PlayStation a little more interesting. For just $9 more, the PS Direct option gets you the newer PS5 design with 1TB of storage, although you'll be giving up Best Buy's $50 reward certificate. If you're happy with digital games, the $499 refurbished PS5 Digital Edition is arguably the most compelling option of the lot, particularly if GTA 6 is the main reason you're buying a console in the first place .

Sony has also announced plans to stop producing physical game discs for new PlayStation releases from January 2028, meaning we're potentially looking at the final few years of physical PlayStation gaming.

That doesn't mean your existing discs suddenly become useless, or that physical games are disappearing overnight, but it does make the $50 saving on a Digital Edition a little more tempting if you're starting from scratch and don't have an existing physical library.

I'd still recommend thinking carefully before going all-in on digital, though. The disc-drive PS5 gives you access to used games, physical discounts, borrowing and reselling games, so that extra $50 isn't necessarily money wasted. But if you have no existing physical library and are comfortable buying digitally, saving that money upfront is certainly a tempting proposition.
Should You Wait for Black Friday?
There's one more date worth keeping in mind if you're thinking about buying a console for GTA 6: Black Friday .

items.title: 苹果发布会的绝对主角！iPhone Ultra来临
items.summary: 苹果正式官宣2026年秋季新品发布会举办时间与主题，本次发布会将于美国加州当地时间9月9日举行，对应北京时间9月10日凌晨1点在Apple…

content.v: 苹果正式官宣2026年秋季新品发布会举办时间与主题，本次发布会将于美国加州当地时间9月9日举行，对应北京时间9月10日凌晨1点在Apple Park乔布斯剧院开启，全程通过苹果官网线上直播，发布会主题定为“Surprise and shine（亮新篇，来耀眼）”。
本次活动堪称苹果年度重磅科技春晚，不仅带来全新直板旗舰iPhone 18 Pro系列，更将首次亮相苹果史上首款折叠屏手机iPhone Ultra，迎来iPhone多年来最大形态革新。
作为本次发布会最大的王牌，iPhone Ultra折叠屏被业内称为苹果外观变化最大的一代机型，彻底打破iPhone直板机固有形态，正式入局高端折叠赛道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281958215290.png
新机采用书本式横向折叠方案，机身便携性做到极致，折叠后的整机尺寸与标准护照大小基本持平，无需再承担“手机+平板”双设备携带负担，完美兼顾日常便携与大屏体验。
iPhone Ultra采用大小双屏组合形态，日常使用体验全面优化。折叠状态下配备5.5英寸外屏，机身宽度控制合理，支持舒适单手操作，无论是单手打字、刷信息流，还是接打电话、视频通话、扫码支付等高频日常操作，都无需展开大屏即可完成。
展开后屏幕尺寸可达7.8英寸，接近小型iPad平板尺寸，大屏视野足以胜任移动办公、追剧观影、多任务处理等沉浸式场景，实现小机身便携、大屏多功能的双重优势。
机身工艺方面，iPhone Ultra创下苹果全新纪录，整机单边厚度仅4.5毫米，成为苹果史上最薄的iPhone机型。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281958326597.png
极致轻薄机身也带来硬件取舍，受限于机身内部堆叠空间，该机取消独立长焦镜头，后置仅保留4800万像素主摄+超广角双摄组合，远景拍摄主要依靠主摄数码裁切实现，影像侧重点偏向日常广角画质，舍弃专业远摄能力。
解锁方案同样迎来重大调整，由于机身轻薄无法容纳3D结构光组件，iPhone Ultra放弃Face ID面容解锁，回归侧边指纹识别方案。
这也是近年来苹果唯一一款仅支持指纹解锁的高端iPhone，彻底打破苹果高端机型全系面容识别的固有格局，解锁体验迎来全新变化。
核心性能层面，iPhone Ultra硬件规格拉满，搭载业界领先的2nm工艺A20 Pro旗舰芯片，搭配12GB大运存，算力与能效相比前代大幅跃升，能够轻松应对大屏分屏、多任务并发、端侧AI运算等高负载场景。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281958425046.png
续航方面，新机内置超5000mAh大容量电池，一举突破iPhone系列续航瓶颈，大幅缓解苹果机型续航短板。
系统体验上，新机出厂预装全新iOS 27系统，针对折叠屏开合形态、大屏分屏交互进行专属深度优化，适配多窗口办公、应用分屏、屏幕自适应切换等特色功能，解决折叠屏适配碎片化问题，为苹果首款折叠屏带来成熟、流畅、高效的专属交互体验。
除折叠屏iPhone Ultra外，本次发布会还将同步推出iPhone 18 Pro系列直板旗舰，新旧形态旗舰同台亮相，标志着苹果手机产品线全面扩容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281958507118.png
随着发布会进入倒计时，这款颠覆苹果百年直板设计、兼具极致轻薄与大屏体验的iPhone Ultra，也成为今年下半年最受期待的高端旗舰机型。

items.title: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说遗产》的游戏总监和主演讲述索菲亚为何如此特别，以及为什么这款前传让团队“呼吸新鲜空气” 2026 年科隆游戏展
items.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy has just been released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC, and we had the chance

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/resonancethumb-1786552854567-1787848367516.png

Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy has just been released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC, and we had the chance at gamescom to speak to David Dedeine, co-founder of Asobo and game director, and Anna Demetriou, Sophia's voice actor, about this big moment for the franchise.

The story being told in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is a prequel that centers on Sophia and her journey to the Minotaur's island to confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse. It's an emotional tale not only for the players, but for Demetriou herself.

"I think sometimes in the acting world, there's a phrase of a character being on center or off center for whoever is playing them," Demetriou said. "For me, Sophia is very much on center. She feels very close to me. This means it hasn't been so much of a stretch to access her or play her. I think we've also delved into her backstory and, as you leave Resonance and you sit in what that game shows you, it makes sense in how you are then led to the Requiem version of her. If there was never anything again, to me, she makes sense and is complete."

Demetriou, after revealing that Just Cause was an important title that helped welcome her into the world of games, said she brought a lot of herself to Sophia and had a great relationship with Resonance's lead writer, Carol Ann Bañuls.

"What was actually really nice on [Resonance] and quite a unique experience was that the person who had originally written Sophia's character in A Plague Tale: Requiem was not the one writing on Resonance," Demetriou said. "We had the amazing Carol Ann Bañuls on this one, who I got on with so well professionally and personally. It all felt very naturally collaborative as I'd already played this character and she was coming to it new.

"This led to a lot of moments of us saying, 'Okay, how can we blend what I know about this character already and what you're bringing to this character that's new and makes something fresh with it together?' She was also so open to, 'Do you like this line? Do you think that she would say something like this?' And I would say, 'Yeah, I like it too!' Or, 'How about we try twisting it, and maybe try this instead?' And she was always up for it. I don't always have that creative freedom as an actor, so it was nice to feel that we got to do this together a lot of the time."
We then chatted with Dedeine about this new story and how it being a prequel offered some interesting challenges.

"There are a lot of different dimensions on this because did not want to disappoint people, as we knew since the beginning that Amicia and Hugo were gone," Dedeine said. "It was not possible to continue on the same vein, and we knew that if we tried to mimic what we did in the past, it would definitely be a wrong move.

"Even in A Plague Tale: Requiem, when we decided to go for the ending we chose, we knew it was the end for a lot of things. So for this, we wanted to open the window a little bit, get some fresh air, and change a little bit the tone too because it's seven years in a row that we've been walking in this universe. However, that concept is a bit complicated because you need to redefine things, and sometimes you fall back too easily on the existing rail and sometimes you try to go too far in the other direction. I think that was the trickiest part, finding this balance between adding the right amount of new flavor while keeping the spirit and the tone we had in the previous games."

One of the biggest changes in this game compared to the previous one is the absence of the iconic swarms of rats. Dedeine assures fans that they shouldn't be worried, because something just as sinister has taken their place.

"There is something very special that replaces the rats, and in a much more dynamic way," Dedeine said. "It's also something we haven't shown because we want to keep it a big surprise, but I think it's something interesting and innovative. I'm curious to see how people are going to react."

Speaking of players reacting, that is happening right now as Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is now available on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC. In our review, we said it is a "prequel spinoff that takes a lot of interesting chances with the series, following a new protagonist, refocusing its encounters around melee combat, and even introducing a whole new way to haunt your dreams."

items.title: '我受够了。我在这个时间线上耗尽了我的运气”：Reddit 因标签错误意外在 RTX 5090 Razer Blade 18 上节省了 5,000 美元
items.summary: Why can't this kind of thing ever happen to me?

content.v: One Redditor has seemingly got the PC hardware deal of the year by paying €2,433 (around $2,800) for a Razer laptop that currently sells for €6,600 (just under $7,700). Gaming laptops may be pricey right now, thanks to the memory crisis , but that would be a steal even pre-memory crisis. All they had to do was get incredibly lucky.

As posted by iiT2 over on the GamingLaptops subreddit, a European buyer bought a Blade 18, with 32 GB of memory, a 1 TB SSD, an RTX 5080 , and an Intel Ultra 9 290 HX Plus. A mighty machine, but modest in comparison to what they were accidentally sent: A Razer Blade 18 with an RTX 5090 , the same Intel chip, a 2 TB SSD, and 64 GB of memory. I put this new configuration together on Razer's website and found out the memory upgrade alone costs an extra €900 (around $1,050) more than the price they actually paid.
The user says, "I‘m done. I used up my luck for this timeline," and given they could have almost purchased three of their original configs for the price of the new one, I'm inclined to agree.

The Razer label and invoice do seem to match with both the machine and the original receipt, so that implies whoever labelled this rig at the Razer factory simply labelled it wrong. That means, inevitably, this would likely have gotten into the hands of some buyer somewhere. Just don't count on it happening again. This is an exceedingly rare mistake on Razer's part.

And what a laptop it is. We at PC Gamer are big fans of what Razer is putting out right now in the gaming laptop space. The most recent Razer Blade 16 got an 86% in our review , with our Andy saying, "It's still one of the best gaming laptops money can buy, but the massive price tag throws me for a loop."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ynCdMda7bvSiEpfPhVue2P.jpg

We also really liked last year's Razer Blade 14 , with its upgraded chassis, gorgeous display, and solid battery life. Razer Blade laptops are pretty expensive, even considering the memory crisis, but their build quality and design are undeniably solid. Plus, they're gorgeous to behold.

We don't technically know if the Redditor will get to keep this laptop, but given it seems to have been sent due to a mislabelling by the vendor selling it, I certainly wouldn't want to give it back. We also don't know if the original vendor would be aware of their mistake, unless informed.

One look at our roundup of the best gaming laptop deals will show you that gaming laptops are in a pretty poor place right now. Around $2400 will get you an RTX 5080 and 16 GB of memory , on sale, and that's because memory, storage, and even GPUs are on the rise price-wise, and unlikely to fall for some time. Luckily, iiT2 now has enough gaming horsepower to wait until the whole thing blows over.

items.title: 自由落体25分钟！iPhone从3万米高空掉落竟毫发无伤
items.summary: 手机配件品牌犀牛盾（RhinoShield）近日联手航天公司Sent Into Space，为其AirX手机壳进行了一次前所未有的极限跌落测试。

content.v: 手机配件品牌犀牛盾（RhinoShield）近日联手航天公司Sent Into Space，为其AirX手机壳进行了一次前所未有的极限跌落测试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281944014861.png
6月24日，团队在瑞典基律纳上空将一部iPhone 17 Pro通过高空气球携带至 30,607米（约100,418英尺） 的高空——超过民航客机巡航高度的三倍——随后将其释放。
在没有降落伞、加热系统或任何额外保护的情况下，手机在 近零下60摄氏度 的低温中经历了约25分钟的自由落体，最终降落在瑞典偏远的荒野中。吉尼斯世界纪录官方要求手机壳本身必须首先与地面接触，而AirX手机壳完美满足了这一条件。回收后，手机可正常开关机、拨打电话并拍摄照片，机身无任何可见损伤。
吉尼斯官方认证团队事后花费超过5小时才在约2公里的搜索范围内找到坠落设备。此次测试正式创下了 “手机壳保护下最高海拔跌落（自然地貌）” 的吉尼斯世界纪录。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281944111657.png
AirX手机壳采用单一可回收材料制成，设计灵感来自汽车安全气囊与运动鞋中的缓震结构。犀牛盾表示，他们在发射前已针对冰冻温度和大气压力进行了模拟测试。“我们做了最坏的打算，但也抱持最好的希望，”品牌体验经理Mujou Hsiao表示。

items.title: 华硕推出全球首款Wi-Fi 8游戏路由器 八爪鱼设计
items.summary: 华硕在今年科隆游戏展（Gamescom 2026）上，推出了ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列，这是全球首款Wi-Fi 8游戏路由器。新产品分为ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro和ROG Raptur

content.v: 华硕在今年科隆游戏展（Gamescom 2026）上，推出了ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列，这是全球首款Wi-Fi 8游戏路由器。新产品分为ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro和ROG Rapture GT-BN98，前者面向美国和加拿大市场，后者覆盖欧洲、中东、非洲、亚太等市场，两者的主要区别在于频段组合略有不同。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260828/1787917925_615591_jpg_r.jpg
ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列延续了之前ROG家族同类产品的标志性“八爪鱼”设计，采用了机甲风格外观，运用了红黑与银灰配色，8根外置铜管式天线配合环状排列扩大了信号覆盖范围。内部搭载了4核心2.6GHz的处理器，搭配2GB内存和256MB闪存，拥有强劲的性能。

ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列属于三频Wi-Fi 8路由器，基于IEEE 802.11bn标准。其中ROG Rapture GT-BN98 Pro由两个6GHz频段加上5GHz频段和2.4GHz频段，分别为2.4G（4T4R，1376Mbps）、5G（4T4R，5764Mbps）6G-1（4T4R，11529Mbps）和6G-2（4T4R，11529Mbps），提供了共30000 Mbps无线连接速率。ROG Rapture GT-BN98则是由两个5GHz频段加上6GHz频段和2.4GHz频段，分别为2.4G（4T4R，1376Mbps）、5G-1（4T4R，5764Mbps）5G-2（4T4R，5764Mbps）和6G（4T4R，11529Mbps），提供了共25000 Mbps无线连接速率。
ROG Rapture GT-BN98系列还提供了一个10G WAN/LAN口、一个10G LAN口、一个2.5G WAN/LAN口、三个2.5G LAN口，以及一个千兆LAN口，支持20Gbps链路聚合功能。另外还有一个USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-A和USB 2.0接口，支持路由器、AiMesh节点、中继器和媒体桥接等多种工作模式。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》30帧能接受？玩家双标现场：R星做的不一样
items.summary: R星公开《GTA6》最新实机演示后，游戏的性能表现迅速成为玩家讨论的焦点。

content.v: 由你来说： GTA6在PS5目标4K 30帧，换成别的游戏锁30早被喷成筛子了，换成R星就情有可原？
R星公开《GTA6》最新实机演示后，游戏的性能表现迅速成为玩家讨论的焦点。此前，受邀参观R星工作室的内容创作者透露，目前游戏在标准版PS5上的目标为4K 30FPS。对于玩家期待的60FPS模式，R星开发负责人则表示目前尚未确定，仍需要进一步评估。
这一消息随即引发玩家热议。值得玩味的是，一些平时对其他游戏锁定30FPS态度强硬的玩家，在面对《GTA6》可能采用30FPS时，却表现出了截然不同的态度，甚至主动为其辩护。这种现象也被部分玩家调侃为“R星例外主义”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281923027521.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281923036585.png
支持者认为，《GTA6》的画面表现、开放世界规模以及NPC和环境模拟都达到了新的高度，在这种情况下牺牲部分帧率可以接受；但反对者则认为，无论开发商是谁，2026年的3A大作依然锁定30FPS都难以令人满意。
有玩家便直接讽刺这种“双重标准”，表示：“只要是R星做的，30帧就能接受了，然后纯数字版也能接受了，豪华版卖100美元也不是问题了，想看Netflix独播的预告需要开会员也忍了。”
归根结底，这场争论的焦点并不只是《GTA6》究竟能否跑60FPS，而是为什么同样的30FPS，换成R星和《GTA6》之后，玩家的容忍度似乎突然变高了。在其他游戏因锁30帧被骂到起飞的情况下，《GTA6》却获得了大量“情有可原”的声音，这种反差也成为本次讨论中最有争议的一点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281923521254.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281923543313.png

items.title: 孙宇晨4500万香蕉扯下来给朋友 还让保姆现粘现分
items.summary: 近日，知名人物孙宇晨因与女星景甜的法律纠纷成为舆论焦点。而随着事件的发酵，一则关于孙宇晨早年花4500万拍下“胶带粘香蕉”艺术…

content.v: 近日，知名人物孙宇晨因与女星景甜的法律纠纷成为舆论焦点。而随着事件的发酵，一则关于孙宇晨早年花4500万拍下“胶带粘香蕉”艺术品的旧事也被翻出，再次引发热议。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281935487538.jpg
据悉，孙宇晨曾花费数百万美元（折合约4500万人民币）拍下意大利艺术家莫瑞吉奥·卡特兰的知名作品《喜剧演员》——一根用胶带粘在墙上的香蕉。
据一位自称与孙宇晨和景甜均有交集的网友在社交平台爆料，他曾在孙宇晨家中做客，当时孙宇晨带着众人参观其豪宅，走到这幅香蕉画前时，他当场扯下香蕉分给在场的朋友，随后让保姆重新粘上一根，再扯下分给下一个人，如此反复操作，分发了多根香蕉。
该网友回忆称，孙宇晨在分香蕉时表示“请你们每人吃了4500万”，暗示每根香蕉都承载着那件艺术品的价值。
对此，该网友坦言内心“无数草泥马在奔腾”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281936299581.jpg
据悉，孙宇晨在拍下该作品后确实曾将香蕉当场吃掉，并称其为“一次艺术体验”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/28/small_202608281936307200.jpg

items.title: 我们在科隆游戏展上了解到的有关银宫的一切
items.titleEn: Everything We Learnt about Silver Palace at gamescom

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/03-1787821628521.jpeg
近期 Beta 测试结束后，在科隆游戏展前夕，全球预注册人数超过 1000 万，开发商和发行商 Elementa 在科隆游戏展久负盛名的 Opening Night Live 上首次推出了开放世界动作角色扮演游戏《Silver Palace》的新预告片。
在针对 PC、移动设备的开发过程中，以及官方宣布将登陆 PlayStation 5（令人惊讶的消息），IGN 来到了科隆游戏展现场，参观了 Silver Palace 展位。如果您还没有看过预告片，现在可以观看，如下：
预告片以一个看起来怪异的手术室开始，医生检查一具由银制成的尸体，然后转移到一座充满蜿蜒街道的广阔城市——我们第一次看到银宫的主角，侦探。预告片随后跟随侦探进行调查、参与战斗并探索城市。角色 Ashley、Gratia 和 Red Rose 的一瞥、Boss 遭遇和手术室展示了游戏的动态战斗和紧张感。在尸体突然破裂，闪闪发光的银色水滴四处飞溅后，预告片揭开了名为“贪婪之屋”的全新多人战斗体验。
正如您所期望的，在展位上，我们有强制性的拍照点和商品区，但也有一个可玩的演示区，我们可以在那里亲身体验银宫。凭借在发布时对 DLSS 4.5 和光线追踪的支持，他们现场拥有的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 PC 让他们有机会展示 Silvernia 世界的沉浸感。

During our hands-on with the demo we were introduced to a mystical world filled with flying silver whales, ornate buildings and fantastical enemies. After a failed assassination attempt on the Queen, the protagonist ⁠– the Detective ⁠– is quickly forced into a boss battle between two huge humanoids emerging from a portal. Combat flowed between light, ranged and ultimate attacks, with dodges and parries helping you avoid damage while keeping the pressure on the enemy. After a spot of exploration in the city of Silvernia on a silverwork horse, we were thrust into another boss encounter, this time against ‘Cinderella’ ⁠– except this version used her horse-drawn pumpkin carriage as a weapon rather than a means to travel to a royal ball. Here we got a taste of the other playable characters who seamlessly switch in and out of combat, each providing a unique moveset and extravagant ultimate ability.

多次现场舞台表演、角色扮演者见面会以及与 iCrimax、HoneyPuu 等的影响者会议为粉丝提供了大量身临其境的机会，他们不仅可以参与游戏，还可以参与场景中的重要人物。所描绘的角色包括侦探、阿尔夫、红玫瑰等几个重要人物，游戏中灰姑娘 Boss 之战中的南瓜马车通过令人印象深刻的雕塑以令人惊叹的时尚方式栩栩如生。展位上的现场乐队表演和舞蹈表演给6号馆带来了活力，对于那些参加围绕他们的活动的人来说，还有大量的奖励，例如艺术卡、盲盒杯垫套装和非常精美的“侦探套装”。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/unnamed-1-1787821360302.png
我们还在科隆的展位上与游戏开发团队花了一些时间，更详细地讨论了一些事情。他们是这样说的：
IGN：你们的《ONL》预告片的基调明显更黑暗、更恐怖，有些观众甚至可能会想起《生化危机》等系列。这感觉和银宫的主基调截然不同。这种对比是故意的吗？

Yes. For this trailer, we intentionally adopted a light horror-inspired editing style, so we understand why some viewers may draw comparisons to well-known horror titles. What we really wanted to highlight, however, was the contrast between Silver Palace’s elegant, fairy-tale-inspired characters and the distorted, unsettling creatures featured in the trailer. That contrast creates a very different atmosphere while still remaining rooted in the world of Silver Palace.
The ONL trailer also teased what looks like a new gameplay mode. Can you tell us more about it?

Yes. The mode, titled House of Greed, is still in an early stage of development and is planned as part of the main game experience. It is designed as a multiplayer mode and uses a classic over-the-shoulder camera and related character-control systems, with a stronger focus on room-based exploration and third-person shooting. The experience is quite different from the main game’s action combat, which centers around a four-character squad and real-time character switching.
You recently passed the huge milestone of 10 million pre-registrations. Is there anything you would like to say to the many players out there who are patiently waiting for Silver Palace?

We received a great deal of valuable feedback from players during both CBT1 and CBT2, and those comments have been extremely important to the entire Silver Palace development team. We’re very grateful to everyone who has been following the game and waiting patiently for its release.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/unnamed-1787821569222.png

在《雪夜枪声》中，玩家将操控一队身怀绝技的角色，在黑雾笼罩的雪原上与穷凶极恶的邪教徒进行残酷的轮盘赌。为了活下去，玩家需要在对敌开枪或朝自己扣动扳机之间抉择，甚至使用各种“卑鄙”的技能与手段让胜利的天平向自己倾斜。
观察，并思考……
在玩家与敌人进行轮盘赌时，双方首先需要交替装填子弹，来决定子弹的排序和开枪优先权，最后完成装弹的一方可以优先进行射击。向自己射击可以继续开枪，朝敌人开枪则会将主动权交给对方……如此推进，直到枪中的实弹都被射出。
合理地排序装弹，并通过空包弹推理出实弹的位置，避开致命枪击，是游戏中赢下对决的基础。
https://image.gcores.com/56d1b2799aa7e2eadec2a0b00995eb0e-1920-1080.png
卑鄙也是活下去的通行证
在游戏中，玩家也可以通过各类技能、道具削弱敌人，从而在轮盘赌中获得巨大优势，甚至不开枪也能赢下决斗。玩家每次向自己开枪都可以获得一颗“勇气宝石”，通过积累、消耗“勇气宝石”，可以发动各种技能：
有的技能可以让正在进行决斗的人下场，替换其他队伍成员继续决斗；有的技能可以直接对敌人造成精神攻击，使其崩溃无法继续战斗；有的技能表面上是投降叛逃，实际上是派出卧底打入敌人内部……
https://image.gcores.com/74283b370cc4c9a1c198a222354443f2-1920-1080.png
不同风格，战至极限
在《雪夜枪声》的正式版中，玩家可操纵的队伍类型由Demo中的1种提升至3种，不同的队伍拥有不同的技能池，也代表了不同的决斗方式。此外，还有3个全新的技能组扩展包，让玩家在基础的建队上获得更多选择。
正式版提供了 4 个难度选项，还有全新的BOSS和真结局路线。在不断臻至极致的挑战中，寻找雪原的尽头吧！

items.title: GTA 6 正在添加 Red Dead Redemption 2 荣誉系统的更细致版本，以确保玩家角色不会过于“全能”
items.summary: Careful when you're in Leonida, it's on sight.

others.title: GTA 6 地图比 Red Dead Redemption 2 大 3 倍

content.v: Two wrongs don't make a right, but one huge wrong and then a lot of little rights can make it feel better. According to Rockstar North's co-studio head Rob Nelson (via IGN ) GTA 6 will be getting this treatment, just a little bit more nuanced.

Think Red Dead Redemption 2's Honor System and then ramp it up a bit. While Arthur Morgan could really game the system, doing the most heinous crimes before working his way back into the good graces of all, Jason and Lucia won't have it quite that easy.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/G4f2zTefXPF8tS4yaTLqWf.jpg

"There isn’t a right or wrong way to play this game, but consistent actions may have an impact in terms of how the world reacts to you and how the narrative plays out," Nelson says. Alongside the classic Wanted Level, players will also have to pay attention to their Criminal Profile.

But here's where the nuance comes in: doing bad things doesn't necessarily count against your Criminal Profile. If you're in a situation where violence is the only logical and safe next step then sure, start shooting, but if you're the aggressor or have even escalated a situation beyond any reasonable amount? NPCs will remember that.

One way to even it out, however, is by Lucia or Jason doing small acts of kindness. Apparently things like throwing your rubbish away in bins or being nice to animals will count in your favour. See, everyone wins when you recycle.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NTkDJYrtXMp4Gn8CjU4cLH.jpg

This isn't Rockstar trying to teach its players mortality, I think we all know it's too late for that, but it is an attempt to make Jason and Lucia's actions a little more realistic. "You are playing as criminals on the run, but the narrative is such that it makes most sense for them to do what they need to do while not drawing unnecessary attention (even though sometimes that happens)," Nelson explains.

It's also just a smart move not to be too much of an asshole when walking around the fictional not-Florida, Leonida. Instead of just having to worry about the police coming for you, now some locals will pick a fight if you taunt them too much, or just a little bit. "I think in previous GTA games you were a bit all-powerful,” Nelson adds. “You were the only one with an invisible arsenal hidden away. Apart from the police, everyone would run in terror from you if you started acting out. This world in GTA 6 is not like that."

But if the noise, violence, and trigger-happy locals of Leonida all get too much for you then you'll be able to just head back to your safehouses, which also take something from RDR2 as they act "closer to the camps in terms of how interactive they are and how much they feel like your home."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZF5ZJsyvbhJRVSDmd9H3jA.jpg
